onset_proxies.method: librosa spectral-flux onset envelopes, delta=.15, wait=.08s, ~10ms hop
onset_proxies.interpretation: Not groove/timing accuracy. Syncopation, subdivisions, fills and quieter piano attacks can legitimately disagree with detected piano onsets. No retiming applied.

limitations: Acoustic drums legitimately have broadband/noisy cymbal and snare components; bass voicing/noise metrics are inappropriate here.
Original generated raw float waveform is absent, so pre-PCM export clipping is not checked. Exported WAVs are verified directly.
No independent meter/downbeat reference or listening evaluation by assistant; no automatic musical-quality verdict.
